definitions.explanation: The main gate or entrance to a school campus. A prominent feature of Japanese schools, often the site of morning greetings by teachers and the backdrop for graduation photos.

examples.japanese: {校門|こうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた→待ち合わせる：12328_machiawaseru⟧。
examples.english: We arranged to meet in front of the school gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、{校門|こうもん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the morning, a teacher was greeting students at the school gate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧、{校門|こうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: On graduation day, I took photos with friends in front of the school gate.

notes:
{校門|こうもん} is the main gate or entrance to a school campus. It holds both practical and symbolic significance in Japanese school culture.

ETYMOLOGY:
{校|こう} (school) + ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ (gate).

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {校門|こうもん} serves as a symbolic boundary between the school and the outside world. Common scenes at the gate:
- Teachers standing at the gate in the morning to greet students (⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧)
- Uniform and appearance checks at strict schools
- Graduation photos taken in front of the gate

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {校門|こうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in front of the school gate
- {校門|こうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる: to pass through the school gate
- {校門|こうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to leave through the school gate

WATCH OUT:
- {肛門|こうもん}: anus (same reading, very different meaning — be careful!)
- ⟦{顧問|こもん}→顧問：16146_komon⟧: adviser (similar but different reading)
